## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

[See more FAQs][31]

_crawl.about: Welcome to Coastal Living Apparel & Beachwear! Founded in 2024, our brand is inspired by a passion for life on the water. Imagine spending a day on the boat or beach with loved ones, soaking up the sun with your favorite drinks, and ending the day with an epic sunset that paints the sky with vibrant colors—this is the essence of coastal living. Whether you're on the beach or out on the water, it's disheartening when you see trash and plastic waste and knowing the impact to marine life. Plastic waste makes up 80% of all marine pollution and around 8 to 10 million metric tons of plastic end up in the ocean each year. To do our part in preserving our oceans, we've partnered with CleanHub to remove one pound of plastic from coastal areas across the world for each item you purchase. We won't stop here. Once we scale, we intend to do more around sustainability and ocean cleanup efforts. Why Choose Us? Ocean Cleanup Initiatives: A portion of every sale goes directly towards funding global coastal cleanup efforts. Quality and Comfort: Enjoy designs inspired by colorful sunsets over the water with the comfort and durability you need for any adventure. Community: Join a community of like-minded individuals who are passionate about making a difference and embrace the coastal lifestyle. Whether you are a surfer, a swimmer, a boater, or simply someone who loves the sound of the waves and the feel of sand between your toes, you belong here. Together, let's celebrate our love for the ocean and contribute to its preservation.

# A Global Leader in Paints and Coatings

The Sherwin-Williams Company delivers the best in paint and coatings products to the world. Every
day, our more than 64,000 employees provide the energy and experience to build on our track record
of success – enabling us to innovate and grow in new and exciting ways. With our people as the
foundation of our Company, we offer industry-leading innovation, value-added service and expertise,
and differentiated distribution to our growing base of professional, industrial, commercial and
consumer customers.

 

Sherwin-Williams has one of the industry’s most recognized portfolios of branded and private-label
products. The Company’s Sherwin-Williams® branded products are sold exclusively through a chain of
more than 5,000 company operated stores and facilities in the United States, Canada, the Caribbean
and Latin America.

 

Additional brands are sold through leading mass merchandisers, home centers, independent paint
dealers, hardware stores, automotive retailers, and industrial distributors across North America and
in parts of Europe, China, Australia and New Zealand. We also supply a broad range of highly
engineered solutions for the construction, industrial, packaging and transportation markets in more
than 130 countries around the world.

_crawl.about: Founded in 1989, Guangzhou Jointas Chemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as JOINTAS Stock Ticker Symbol:002909.SZ) is a hi-tech enterprise of the National Torch Program specialized in the production of sealant and coating products, which are widely used in fields of 🔆constructional engineering, 🔆home decoration, 🔆container manufacturing, 🔆steel structure manufacturing, 🔆electronic device, 🔆petrochemical equipment, 🔆shipping and yacht, etc. JOINTAS owns two famous brands: antas and JOINTS. Adhering to the business concepts of 'Green environmental protection, professional quality', after years of technology research and development, innovation and accumulation, the company has established good brand awareness and customer base and won series honors. JOINTAS has also ranked among the top three construction glue brands most favored by users with superior market performance in the selection organized by the alwindoor.com for 14 consecutive years and top-3 brand in real estate enterprises for 6 consecutive years. Today, Jointas has already established over 40 branches in China and several agency departments in Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam, Australia, New Zealand, Kazakhstan, Turkey, Pakistan, etc. to supply one-stop service to customers in the whole world.

_crawl.about: Paintzen is now Arch Painting’s residential painting division. Now, homeowners seeking instant prices, crews on site in as few as five days and the experience of three decades of painting professionalism can get it all at Paintzen. Our 5x5 pledge - 5 minutes to quote, 5 days to service - is transforming residential painting and, more important, Your Painting Experience! Paintzen was founded in 2013 as a consumer-facing, on-demand booking tool to help homeowners and renters easily find qualified professionals to paint their interiors. Since then, the service has expanded to become a go-to resource for consumers and designers. Under Arch Painting, Paintzen now combines the power of technology and painting services in one convenient platform. With a few swift keystrokes, customers can use the technology interface for automated pricing, booking and painting delivery. In a world where time is precious and people increasingly rely on technology-enabled solutions for convenience and access, Paintzen fundamentally changes the contracting and delivery process, allowing users to seamlessly access a dedicated project coordinator and an experienced painting crew, backed by Arch, a 27-year-old, premiere painting brand. Learn more about Paintzen at www.paintzen.com.

Still headquartered in New York, we continue to manufacture and sell specialty, professional cosmetics for face & body paint, special FX, theater, film, cosplay, Halloween, and creative beauty markets. ## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

## FAQ

#### Are Arteza acrylic paints good for beginners?

Yes. Arteza acrylics are a solid starting point for beginners — they’re easy to work with, come in
large color sets, and are priced reasonably without sacrificing too much on quality.

#### What surfaces can I use Arteza acrylic paint on?

Arteza acrylics work well on canvas, wood, paper, fabric, rocks, ceramic, and more. For best results
on non-porous surfaces like glass or plastic, a primer or sealant is recommended.

#### Are these paints safe to use?

Yes, Arteza acrylic paints are non-toxic and generally safe for adults and older children. Always
check the label and keep them away from very young children.

#### Do Arteza acrylics dry out quickly?

Like most acrylics, they dry faster than oil paints — usually within 20 to 30 minutes depending on
the thickness of the layer and room conditions. Using a stay-wet palette can help keep the paint
workable longer.

#### Do Arteza acrylic paints work for professional artists?

They can hold their own for professional use, especially for artists who go through a lot of paint.
That said, artists who need museum-grade lightfastness may want to supplement with artist-grade
paints for finished pieces meant to last long-term.

#### What’s the difference between Arteza acrylic sets?

Arteza offers sets in different sizes — from compact 12-color sets for travel or beginners, up to
60-color sets for artists who want a full range. Some sets also include metallics, neons, or earth
tones for more specific projects.

# A Global Leader in Paints and Coatings

The Sherwin-Williams Company delivers the best in paint and coatings products to the world. Every
day, our more than 64,000 employees provide the energy and experience to build on our track record
of success – enabling us to innovate and grow in new and exciting ways. With our people as the
foundation of our Company, we offer industry-leading innovation, value-added service and expertise,
and differentiated distribution to our growing base of professional, industrial, commercial and
consumer customers.

 

Sherwin-Williams has one of the industry’s most recognized portfolios of branded and private-label
products. The Company’s Sherwin-Williams® branded products are sold exclusively through a chain of
more than 5,000 company operated stores and facilities in the United States, Canada, the Caribbean
and Latin America.

 

Additional brands are sold through leading mass merchandisers, home centers, independent paint
dealers, hardware stores, automotive retailers, and industrial distributors across North America and
in parts of Europe, China, Australia and New Zealand. We also supply a broad range of highly
engineered solutions for the construction, industrial, packaging and transportation markets in more
than 130 countries around the world.

## Are touch-ups and field failures increasing your project cost?

Kroma Paints systems reduce touch-ups by up to 50% with factory-proven adhesion.

Our 3-coat system gives 7–10 year durability, backed by ISO 12944 and salt spray testing.

Fast-drying, low-VOC coatings optimized for tight project schedules and remote applications.

## Do you get enough corrosion protection in coastal or humid zones?

Engineered systems built for C3–C5 environments, salt spray tested to 1000+ hours.

## Do you get the desired aesthetic appeal after coating?

Smooth finishes with long-lasting color retention and low chalking topcoats.

## Are you getting real technical support and system design help?

We offer on-site technical advisors and application support at every project stage.

Kroma’s controlled formulations ensure shade consistency across drums, batches & jobs.

from customers, peers and the society. The company insists on technological innovation, strict
product quality requirements, customer needs as the center, customer satisfaction as the starting

## About UO US

Urban Outfitters US is a lifestyle retailer dedicated to inspiring customers through a unique
combination of product, creativity and cultural understanding. Founded in 1970 in a small space
across the street from the University of Pennsylvania, Urban Outfitters US now operates over 200
stores in the United States, Canada and Europe, offering experiential retail environments and a
well-curated mix of on-trend women’s and [men’s clothes][73], from boho dresses, denim and graphics
to shoes, hats, and backpacks, as well as beauty, [intimates][74], swim and a collection of
handpicked vintage clothing. Urban Outfitters also carries everything you need to decorate your
[small space][75], apartment or dorm, with a UO Home collection that includes [bedding][76],
tapestries, rugs, shower curtains and [furniture][77]. Our Music + Tech collection is a go-to
destination for vinyl, [record players][78] and tech accessories. Visit our stores, where all are
welcome and there’s always something new to see, or shop online at UrbanOutfitters.com and get free
shipping on qualifying US orders. For special offers, one-of-a-kind prizes and more, download the UO
US app and join [UO Rewards][79]! Want to be part of the conversation? Follow, share and shop

## Our Company

In the year 1968, under the stewardship of Mr. Pravinchandra B Shah, Vipul Group of companies began
its Napthol, Fast color bases and dye intermediates business. What began as a small venture,
expanded at a rapid pace and set up its manufacturing facility at Thane, outskirts of Mumbai.

Vipul Dye Chem was established in 1972, which was later renamed **Vipul Organics Limited**, to
reflect the product portfolio in the year 2017. Vipul Organics Limited is celebrating its Golden
Jubilee and is "50 years young" in the Color Industry.

In 1989, the second generation of the promoters, Mr. Vipul P Shah, joined the company, after
completing his Chemical Engineering. He was the one who really gave wings to the company's growth
story. **Vipul Organics** now also ventured into the pigments segment, making it a holistic Dyes and
Pigments company that has one-stop products and solutions for anything to do with the category.

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

# Arteza: Premium Acrylic Paint Sets, Professional Art Markers and Iridescent Pouring Supplies

Whether you’re just starting out or have years of work behind you, Arteza acrylics deliver rich,
vibrant pigments that hold up on canvas, wood, paper, and more — so your work always looks exactly
the way you intended.

[View Collection][17]

### **Rich, Vibrant Pigments**

Arteza acrylics are packed with high-quality pigment, so the colors you see on the palette are the
colors you get on your canvas — bold, saturated, and true to tone even after drying.

### **Works on Almost Any Surface**

Canvas, wood, paper, fabric, rocks — Arteza acrylics stick well to a wide range of surfaces, which
makes them a practical choice for all kinds of projects, not just traditional painting.

### **Great Value for the Price**

You get a lot of paint for the cost. Arteza is known for offering large sets at affordable prices,
which means artists at any budget level can keep creating without constantly running out of
supplies.

## Choose Your Color Story

Every painting starts with a decision — warm or cool, bold or subtle, chaotic or calm. Pick the
colors that match what you’re feeling and let the work take it from there.

[Arteza Gouache Paint set of 60 colorful 12ml tubes arranged in rows]

Rich, opaque color in 60 ready-to-use tubes — ideal for both students learning the basics and

### Real Brush Pens, Set of 96

96 water-based brush pens with flexible nylon tips packed into a portable organizer case — a go-to
set for drawing, lettering, coloring, and watercolor-style work all in one place.

[Check Price][20]
[Arteza Acrylic Paint Markers set of 20 pens in assorted colors with painted swatches]

### Acrylic Paint Markers, Set of 20 Acrylic Paint Pens

20 acrylic paint markers in assorted colors that work on just about any surface — glass, pottery,
ceramic, plastic, rocks, and canvas — making them a versatile pick for artists who like to paint
beyond the traditional canvas.

[Check Price][21]
[Arteza Metallic Watercolor Paint set of 24 shimmer half pans in metal tin with water brush pen]

### Metallic Watercolor Paint Set, 24 Shimmer Colors

24 shimmer metallic watercolor shades in a sleek metal tin, complete with a water brush pen —
perfect for adding a glowing, reflective touch to lettering, calligraphy, cards, journals, and any
art project that deserves a little shine.

[Check Price][22]
[Arteza 12 Metallic Glitter Watercolor half pans travel set with brush pen]

## About brand

Arteza has built a reputation for making art supplies that are accessible to a wide range of people
— from kids picking up a brush for the first time to working artists who paint every day. The
acrylic paint line sits at the center of that mission.

The paints are known for their strong pigmentation, which means colors stay rich and vibrant on the
surface rather than looking washed out after drying. They blend well, dry relatively quickly, and
hold up on a variety of surfaces including canvas, wood, paper, and fabric — which makes them a
practical choice for different styles and techniques.

One of the things that sets Arteza apart is the pricing. The sets tend to offer a generous number of
colors at a price point that doesn’t push beginners away or drain the budget of more serious
artists. Large sets with 60 or more colors are common, giving painters room to work without
constantly mixing or running short.

The consistency across tubes is reliable enough that artists can count on getting the same result
from one session to the next — something that matters when working on longer projects or series.

Whether someone is painting landscapes, doing pour art, working on a commission, or just
experimenting on a weekend, Arteza acrylics are designed to keep up without getting in the way.

## FAQ

#### Are Arteza acrylic paints good for beginners?

Yes. Arteza acrylics are a solid starting point for beginners — they’re easy to work with, come in
large color sets, and are priced reasonably without sacrificing too much on quality.

#### What surfaces can I use Arteza acrylic paint on?

Arteza acrylics work well on canvas, wood, paper, fabric, rocks, ceramic, and more. For best results
on non-porous surfaces like glass or plastic, a primer or sealant is recommended.

#### Are these paints safe to use?

Yes, Arteza acrylic paints are non-toxic and generally safe for adults and older children. Always
check the label and keep them away from very young children.

#### Do Arteza acrylics dry out quickly?

Like most acrylics, they dry faster than oil paints — usually within 20 to 30 minutes depending on
the thickness of the layer and room conditions. Using a stay-wet palette can help keep the paint
workable longer.

#### Do Arteza acrylic paints work for professional artists?

They can hold their own for professional use, especially for artists who go through a lot of paint.
That said, artists who need museum-grade lightfastness may want to supplement with artist-grade
paints for finished pieces meant to last long-term.

#### What’s the difference between Arteza acrylic sets?

Arteza offers sets in different sizes — from compact 12-color sets for travel or beginners, up to
60-color sets for artists who want a full range. Some sets also include metallics, neons, or earth
tones for more specific projects.

## Our Services

### Exterior Painting

The first thing people notice when pulling up to your home is the color. With a quality paint job,
your home will be brighter and better looking than most. Your neighbors may even get a bit jealous.

Another benefit of exterior paint jobs is that your home’s value will rise, so if you’ve been
thinking about listing your home this is a great way to get the most out of your home.

The final benefit is that you get an extra layer of protection, this will help seal any water, bugs,
or whatever may be thrown its way.

If you’re looking to get the exterior of your home painted, be sure to give Hillis Brothers Painting
a call to get started.

[ Learn More ][53]

### Interior Painting

Whether you’re looking to get one room painted or the whole home, here at Hillis Brothers Painting
we can do it all.

Just from a simple paint job, you can completely transform your home. Not only will the paint
brighten up any room, but it will also impress guests.

Maybe you want to brighten up a room or even make a room for relaxation, the color of your room has
a huge impact on your mind. Regardless, you spend most of your time inside so it should always put a
smile on your face.

If you’re looking for an interior paint job, give us a call and we’ll get the process started.

[ Learn More ][54]

### Cabinet Painting

Every day you see and use your kitchen cabinets, this can lead to them getting.. Well.. boring.

If you’re looking to freshen up your kitchen, one of the best ways to do so is by painting your
cabinets. Not only will this save thousands on new cabinets but it can easily be transformed into a
picture-perfect kitchen.

Painting cabinets require a keen eye for detail, steady hands, and patience. There’s no need for you
to stress about this.

Give us a call and we’ll not only take this stress off your shoulders but also provide that magazine
cover kitchen you’ve always dreamt of.

### Commercial Painting

We may be called Hillis Brothers Painting, but we do commercial painting, too. From malls, movie
theaters, restaurants, office buildings, and warehouses, we can paint it all. We take pride in
painting homes and treat every doorstep like it’s our own, but the simple fact is that the stakes
are raised when it comes to commercial painting.

You can’t just trust two guys in a truck to paint in the presence of your customers and business
environment. You need to trust painters that run a busineess themselves, thus knowing how business
works. You can find that in Hillis Brothers Painting.

What Should I Look For In A Painter?

When looking to hire a painter for a residential or commercial project, there are a few things
you’ll want to look for.
* **Professionalism: **You may think that pure skill should come first, but the most important thing
  is the professionalism of the company you’re hiring. Will they show up on time and will the do the
  work they promised or dissapear with your money?
* **Quality: **You don’t just want to hire a skilled painter, but also a painter that uses the best
  quality material. This includes paint, primer, rollers, and pressure washing equipment.
* **Licensed & Insured: **Make sure to check that the painter you hire is licensed and insured. Our
  state contractor license number is 997544 and our DIR number is 1000026519. We bonded, insured,
  and LEAD certified.

Yes. Most people we work for are not home the whole time we work. Whether you need to work, run

## Our Company

In the year 1968, under the stewardship of Mr. Pravinchandra B Shah, Vipul Group of companies began
its Napthol, Fast color bases and dye intermediates business. What began as a small venture,
expanded at a rapid pace and set up its manufacturing facility at Thane, outskirts of Mumbai.

Vipul Dye Chem was established in 1972, which was later renamed **Vipul Organics Limited**, to
reflect the product portfolio in the year 2017. Vipul Organics Limited is celebrating its Golden
Jubilee and is "50 years young" in the Color Industry.

In 1989, the second generation of the promoters, Mr. Vipul P Shah, joined the company, after
completing his Chemical Engineering. He was the one who really gave wings to the company's growth
story. **Vipul Organics** now also ventured into the pigments segment, making it a holistic Dyes and
Pigments company that has one-stop products and solutions for anything to do with the category.
